label: Source artifact truth
query: Show the current Source truth for LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 by stage, including what remains in review.
answer: My read: For Lakeshore Holdings, the Source truth on LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 is that Strategy through BAFO are artifact-backed and approved; Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value are still in review / needs-review states and are not decision-complete. Why: The loaded tenant substrate explicitly flags LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 as a document-real Kyriba Source event with a full artifact spine, and it shows Strategy, Evaluation, and BAFO as approved stages. That means the business case, options analysis, and BAFO recommendation artifacts exist, are stored, and have passed their sponsor gates. The same substrate marks Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value as review/needs-review demo states — no proof yet that the final approval owner (typically CFO+CIO or board, depending on the dollar band) has executed an Executive Decision, no Selection contract artifact, and no Transition or Value realization evidence. Stage-by-stage truth: Strategy – Approved, artifact spine present (strategy brief, high-level business case). Evaluation – Approved, artifact spine present (RFP/assessment, scorecards). BAFO – Approved, artifact spine present (BAFO recommendation, decision pack). Executive Decision – In review / needs-review; no stored Executive Decision artifact with CFO/CIO or board approval proof. Selection – In review / needs-review; no final selection/contract artifact locked in Source. Transition – In review / needs-review; cutover plan and no-go conditions not evidenced as approved. Value – In review / needs-review; the loaded evidence does not show stored value ledger or realized-benefit evidence.
